item.title: Prompt Payment Interest Rate July 1, 2026 - December 31, 2026
item.description:
Mayor's Office of Contract Services | Special Materials | Notice

Section 4-06 of the Procurement Policy Rules requires City agencies to process contract payments efficiently and expeditiously so as to assure timely contract payments to those suppliers doing business with the City. 

The Rule further requires that when payments are made after the Required Payment Date ('RPD'), interest, unless otherwise specified in the Rules, must be paid to the supplier. 

The Comptroller and the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) have jointly set the new Prompt Payment Interest Rate. The new Prompt Payment Interest Rate is 4.75% effective on payments for the six month period July 1, 2026 - December 31, 2026. 

 

Questions on this notice should be directed to: 

Kimberly Egbert  

Mayor's Office of Contract Services 

255 Greenwich Street, 9th Floor 

New York, NY 10007 

212-298-0887

kimberly.egbert@mocs.nyc.gov

item.title: Notice of Adopted Final Report
item.description:
Charter Revision Commission | Special Materials | Notice

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the New York City Charter Revision Commission appointed in December 2025 has issued its Adopted Final Report, dated June 25, 2026. The Adopted Final Report is available for public review at: https://dechert.box.com/s/sk211wqnr9em96mi7mwpwwnjmy4ddsyu.

NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN that the Commissions ballot proposal to establish non-partisan local elections with open primaries was unanimously approved by the Commission for placement on the November 2026 General Election ballot. The ballot proposal was transmitted to the New York City Clerk on May 27, 2026, and, following the Commissions adoption of a revised and corrected amendment, was retransmitted on June 25, 2026. The ballot proposal and amended submission are available for public review at: https://dechert.box.com/s/qwga6ahtb8yzj3mpkh2mqkt6jo657ii9.

item.title: Concept Paper for Criminal Justice Transition Network (CJTN) RFP - RFI EPIN12826Y0019
item.description:
Mayor's Office of Criminal Justice | Special Materials | Notice | Hearing: 2026-06-16

Notice of Concept Paper

The New York City Mayors Office of Criminal Justice (MOCJ) seeks to issue a Request for Proposals (RFP) to provide transition services in every borough within NYC (Queens, Manhattan, Brooklyn, Bronx, and Staten Island). Last year approximately 14,000 people left New York Citys jails and returned to their communities. Although many are successful in making the transition home, each year approximately 37% return to the citys custody within one year of release. Reincarceration is a driver of the Citys jail population. Connections to person-centered appropriate reentry services are key to stabilization in community, ultimately reducing reincarceration. Despite reincarceration rates, New York City has one of the lowest incarceration rates of all large cities in the United States, per capita, with an average daily jail population of approximately 7,000 as of October 2025. item.title: Notice Regarding Charter Revision Commission Appointed December 31, 2025
item.description:
Office of the Mayor | Special Materials | Notice

May 27, 2026 

Pursuant to Section 36(4)(b) of the Municipal Home Rule Law, I hereby decline to confirm the continued existence of the Charter Revision Commission appointed by former Mayor Eric Adams on December 31, 2025. In accordance with Section 36(4)(b), such Commission shall expire and all appointments to such Commission, as well as any proposed revisions to the City Charter or any new proposed Charter put forth by such Commission, shall be nullified.

__________________________
Zohran Kwame Mamdani
Mayor
